definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is quiet and unsmiling, often appearing to be in a bad mood. Used as an adverb (with する) or to describe a personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むっつり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He sat there in sullen silence and said nothing.

examples.japanese: むっつり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: He left the room with a sullen expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むっつり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has a taciturn personality, but he often smiles in front of his grandchildren.

notes:
Onomatopoeic-feeling adverb suggesting an unsmiling, silent, possibly sulky demeanor. Typically used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or as a modifier with ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- むっつり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be sullen/silent
- むっつり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a sullen face
- むっつり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a taciturn personality
- むっつり⟦{黙|だま}り{込|こ}む→黙り込む：18270_damarikomu⟧: to clam up in sullen silence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- むすっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: sullenly; in a sulk — emphasizes a more momentary, visible sulk
- ⟦{黙々|もくもく}→黙々：14712_mokumoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: silently (working) — neutral; no implication of bad mood
- ⟦{無口|むくち}→無口：06644_mukuchi⟧: taciturn; of few words — neutral personality descriptor without the sulky nuance
